description.en: The ID of the Kubernetes cluster.

description.zh: 路由规则名称。只能为小写字母、数字和短划线（-），必须以小写字母开头，不以短划线（-）结尾，长度不超过63个字符。
description.en: The name of the Ingress. The name can contain lowercase letters, digits, and hyphens (-). It must start with a lowercase letter but cannot end with a hyphen (-). The name can be up to 63 characters in length.
The namespace of the Kubernetes cluster.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun edas update-k8s-ingress-rule --cluster-id 5b2b4ab4-efbc-4a81-9c45-xxxxxxxxxxxxx --namespace default --name my-ingress-rule --ingress-conf rules_:_host_:_abc.com_,_secretName_:_tls-secret_,_paths_:_path_:_/path_,_backend_:_servicePort_:80,_serviceName_:_xxx --annotations nginx.ingress.kubernetes.io/ssl-redirect_:_true_,_nginx.ingress.kubernetes.io/configuration-snippet_:_set_test_value --labels test-label_:_test-label-value --region cn-hangzhou
